qualification: Cold native common-caller replays use unchanged archived public returns. Every current command is computed before the host supplies its expected return. The unchanged historical comparator supplies the same 17 checks and check labels: commands, complete public-packet hashes, animation lengths, primitive boundaries, selected family/group/proposal kind/subquestion, named coordination entry/guard fields, prefix lengths, epoch anchors, source-series event counts, common-caller counters, natural level boundaries and final public result. Only fresh observation-session prefixes are normalized in the selected fields. Timings, implementation labels and migration-status labels are excluded. Complete provider payloads, derived identities, graph chains/revisions, full original-caller parity and equality of newly added family state are not asserted. Original payloads remain in the complete reports. These are recorded-return regressions, not new live game successes or a speed comparison. Legacy v53/v54 labels in the reused comparator identify its provenance; the case manifest and frozen source identify the actual baselines and current execution.
